{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-la-e","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"8769d3ab25a39d46be1b6a9274058fc99fda2edf477c7cd63887c5fd3a9df64e","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-la-class-std:lineage:42","source_registry_sha256":"8fb2294cb50570a3a0fabb25acba3418dba999eb7dd305cc58b73fdf38975613","source_liveness_sha256":"1105a92b5841d065519de4b7fbea05111880de6d2bb8804066a972d19c63b5a0"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Sharing with bicycles, motorcycles and trucks","heading":"Sharing with bicycles, motorcycles and trucks","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"# Sharing with bicycles, motorcycles and trucks

FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A01
Large trucks need more room to stop and maneuver than passenger vehicles. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0088]

FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A01
Do not cut into the open space in front of a truck because that space is needed for stopping. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0088]

FACT_ID: sec10-R03 | anchor: A01
A vehicle very close in front of a long-hooded truck may be hidden from its driver. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0088]

FACT_ID: sec10-R04 | anchor: A01
Do not remain alongside a truck in its blind spot. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0088]

FACT_ID: sec10-R05 | anchor: A01
If the truck driver’s face cannot be seen in a mirror, the guide warns that the driver may not see the nearby vehicle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0088]

FACT_ID: sec10-R06 | anchor: A01
If following so closely that the truck’s side mirrors cannot be seen, increase the gap. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0088]

FACT_ID: sec10-R07 | anchor: A01
Give a turning truck ample room because its blind spots and the relationship of cab and trailer change during the turn. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0088]

FACT_ID: sec10-R08 | anchor: A01
Leave extra room behind a truck stopped on an incline in case it rolls backward when starting. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0088]

FACT_ID: sec10-R09 | anchor: A01
Avoid staying beside a truck longer than necessary during windy weather. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0088]

FACT_ID: sec10-R10 | anchor: A01
Maintain firm control of the wheel when passing a truck because air turbulence can affect the smaller vehicle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0088]

FACT_ID: sec10-R11 | anchor: A01
A large truck generally takes longer than a car to accelerate, stop or be passed. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0088]

FACT_ID: sec10-R12 | anchor: A02
In good conditions, the guide recommends a four-to-five-second following interval behind a truck. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R13 | anchor: A02
Leave an even longer gap behind a truck in poor weather or road conditions. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R14 | anchor: A02
Following farther behind a truck improves the view ahead and reduces exposure to wheel spray. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R15 | anchor: A02
Keep low beams on when following a truck at night because bright beams reflect from its mirrors toward the driver. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R16 | anchor: A02
Mudguards reduce debris but do not eliminate water spray from a truck’s wheels. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R17 | anchor: A02
Maintain clean glass and effective wipers when traveling near trucks in rain. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R18 | anchor: A02
Prepare the wipers before an oncoming truck passes in rain so spray is cleared promptly. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R19 | anchor: A02
Do not start passing a truck unless the road ahead can be seen clearly. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R20 | anchor: A02
Increase separation from a truck to reduce the effect of its spray on visibility. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R21 | anchor: A02
Truck no-zones are areas at the front, rear and sides where nearby vehicles can be hidden from the driver. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R22 | anchor: A03
The guide directs motorists to pass a truck on its left. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-R23 | anchor: A03
Before returning in front after passing a truck, wait until the whole truck front is visible in the rear-view mirror. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-R24 | anchor: A03
Allow a truck room to merge, remembering that it needs longer to reach highway speed. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-R25 | anchor: A03
Watch a large vehicle’s turn signal because a right turn may start with a swing toward the left. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-R26 | anchor: A03
Never drive between a right-turning truck or bus and the curb. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-R27 | anchor: A03
Wait for a truck or bus to finish turning before attempting to turn beside it. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0090]
